Package index

All functions

bulk_file_rename()
Bulk search and replace in file names
clip_c_elements()
Copy a vector to the clipboard as R code
data_collator_gorilla()
Merge and load in data from multiple gorilla downloads
data_merger()
Load in and merge data from multiple files into one data.table
data_merger_gorilla()
Load in and merge the data from one gorilla download
exclorr()
Explore correlations between large numbers of variables
filtered_datalist()
Filter a whole list of data tables on one column
gorilla_eye_plot()
Plot eye movements for one trial (or trial type)
gorilla_eye_processing()
Process gorilla eye tracking data and label it with zone information
gorilla_eye_processing_old()
Process gorilla eye tracking data (earlier gorilla format)
gorilla_iatanalysis()
Process and analyse IAT data from gorilla
gorilla_q_bmis()
Score the BMIS mood survey
gorilla_q_checkbox()
Score checkbox items
gorilla_q_keyed()
Score a gorilla questionnaire using a survey key
gorilla_q_keyed_qb2()
Score a gorilla Questionnaire Builder 2 questionnaire using a survey key
gorilla_q_parse()
Get unscored questionnaire answers from gorilla
gorilla_q_parse_qb2()
Get unscored questionnaire answers from gorilla (Questionnaire Builder 2)
gorilla_q_performance_engagement()
Score the performance engagement questionnaire
gorilla_q_rankscore()
Score ranked items
gorilla_q_tipi()
Score the TIPI ten item personality scale
lab_assignment_files()
Tidy up the files from a moodle assignment download
pid_merge()
Merge data tables together on participant id
pirateye()
Plot data as a pirate plot (RDI: raw data, descriptives, inferences)
plot_model()
Plot the output of an ANOVA or mixed model
plotscat()
Plot a scatterplot of two or three variables, optionally split by group
readin_datalist()
Read in a set of data files and store them in a list
replacecondcols()
Get colours for the levels of a condition
resolve.args()
Combine argument lists, with earlier ones taking priority
saveout_datalist()
Save a list of data tables to a folder of .csv files
singlecor()
Single correlation with r, p value and optionally a Bayes factor
